You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From e5e6268f77badf18bd6ab435364cfe21c7396c31 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Martin Kepplinger <martin.kepplinger@puri.sm>
Date: Wed, 24 Nov 2021 09:37:03 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] arm64: dts: imx8mq: remove interconnect property from lcdif

The mxsfb driver handling imx8mq lcdif doesn't yet request the
interconnect bandwidth that's needed at runtime when the description is
present in the DT node.

So remove that description and bring it back when it's supported.

Fixes: ad1abc8a03fd ("arm64: dts: imx8mq: Add interconnect for lcdif")
Signed-off-by: Martin Kepplinger <martin.kepplinger@puri.sm>
Signed-off-by: Shawn Guo <shawnguo@kernel.org>
---
 arch/arm64/boot/dts/freescale/imx8mq.dtsi | 2 --
 1 file changed, 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/arch/arm64/boot/dts/freescale/imx8mq.dtsi b/arch/arm64/boot/dts/freescale/imx8mq.dtsi
index 972766b67a15..71bf497f99c2 100644
--- a/arch/arm64/boot/dts/freescale/imx8mq.dtsi
+++ b/arch/arm64/boot/dts/freescale/imx8mq.dtsi
@@ -524,8 +524,6 @@ lcdif: lcd-controller@30320000 {
 						  <&clk IMX8MQ_VIDEO_PLL1>,
 						  <&clk IMX8MQ_VIDEO_PLL1_OUT>;
 				assigned-clock-rates = <0>, <0>, <0>, <594000000>;
-				interconnects = <&noc IMX8MQ_ICM_LCDIF &noc IMX8MQ_ICS_DRAM>;
-				interconnect-names = "dram";
 				status = "disabled";
 
 				port@0 {
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The mxsfb driver for the imx8mq platform was not properly handling the interconnect bandwidth requests at runtime when the interconnect property was defined in the device tree (DT) node for the LCD interface (lcdif). This oversight led to potential issues in managing the necessary bandwidth for the LCD controller, prompting the removal of the interconnect property until proper support is implemented.

You are a programming expert.
    You will be given the root cause of a bug and  the corresponding patch.
    You need to extract the code statements that lead to the bug from  the patch, based on the root cause.

    
    Provide a response strictly in the following format:
    Code statements:
    <text1>
    <text2>
    <text3>
    <text4>
    ...
    <textN>

Root cause:
The mxsfb driver for the imx8mq platform was not properly handling the interconnect bandwidth requests at runtime when the interconnect property was defined in the device tree (DT) node for the LCD interface (lcdif). This oversight led to potential issues in managing the necessary bandwidth for the LCD controller, prompting the removal of the interconnect property until proper support is implemented.
